name: singlet_ingest_quant_intron_inclusive_gene_counting
title: Intron-inclusive gene counting
description: Counts intronic (pre-mRNA) molecules with a chosen engine and writes exonic, intronic and total gene matrices plus a per-barcode nuclear fraction. Use it for single-nucleus libraries, or for whole cells when intronic counts are wanted, with a reference built with intron sequence by singlet_ingest_quant_reference_annotation_build. It does not call cells or normalise counts, and it should not be used when exon-only counts answer the question, because inclusion changes the estimand.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI with raw or tagged reads, or a workspace handle.

method.description: Counting engine: starsolo (GeneFull family), kb_nac (nascent, mature, ambiguous) or alevin_fry_usa (splicing states).

feature.description: Counts that populate X. auto gives exon for whole cells and gene_full for nuclei; overlap variants need starsolo.

reference.description: Reference bundle handle from the build step; defaults to the dataset's uns/ref_build.

starsolo.description: Options used only when method is starsolo.

umi_dedup.description: UMI collapsing rule; 1MM_All collapses UMIs one mismatch apart.

cb_match.description: Cell barcode matching to the whitelist, as documented by STARsolo.

cell_filter.description: STARsolo cell filter string: filter type, then expected cells, percentile and ratio.

kb.description: Options used only when method is kb_nac.

nascent_matrices.description: Return nascent, mature and ambiguous matrices from the nac index.

intron_flank.description: Bases of flank added to intron sequence; null applies the kb-python default.

alevin_fry.description: Options used only when method is alevin_fry_usa.

resolution.description: UMI resolution in USA mode; only these two strategies are available there.

rho_model.description: Options for the proposed hierarchical pre-mRNA ratio model; requires feature gene_full.

enabled.description: Fit the hierarchical pre-mRNA ratio model and write models/rho_hierarchical.

device.description: Execution device; counting runs in the engine, and cuda serves the rho model and reductions.

seed.description: Random seed for the rho model fit; ignored when rho_model.enabled is false.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. layers/intronic. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: n_cells, median_genes_per_cell, median_nuclear_fraction, intronic_share, method, feature. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
